notes.title: 🚨 Patch Update [2.0.4.28] & [Creator 2.0.2] is Live! 🚨
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We’ve just rolled out an exciting new patch that’s packed with awesome updates and fixes!

🎣 What’s New?

Dive into an all-new fishing experience with revamped mechanics.
Start your farming journey at Ellondel Farm, where you can now plant, harvest, and sell your crops.
Enjoy the serene sounds of ambient background music in every environment.

🐛 What’s Fixed?

No more overlapping UIs or muted audio on first launch—we’ve squashed those bugs for good!


🛠️ For Our Creators:

The file browser now remembers your last used path, and your most recent avatar preset loads automatically (don’t forget to create new ones!) We also fixed a bunch of annoying bugs that was preventing submissions in some scenarios.


Jump in and explore all the new features and bug fixes waiting for you. As always, thank you for your support and happy gaming! 🚀🎉

Thanks,
The VX Team

notes.title: Celebrate Pride in Piffsy! Join Us for an Unforgettable Event!
notes.content:
[b]Dear Piffsy Community,[/b]

We are thrilled to invite you to our special in-game Pride Event, a celebration of diversity, inclusion, and love for everyone in the Piffsy community! 🌈💖

[b]Event Highlights:[/b]

🏳️‍🌈 Pride Event Zone: Dive into our specially designed Pride Event Zone, a vibrant and welcoming space where you can hang out, meet new friends, and celebrate together.

🏳️‍🌈 Exclusive Props & Flags: Show your pride and support for the LGBTQ+ community by purchasing exclusive props and flags at a low cost. These unique items are available only during the event, so don't miss out!

🏳️‍🌈 Pride Decorations: Experience the world of Piffsy like never before with stunning Pride-themed decorations throughout the game. Enjoy the festive and inclusive atmosphere as you explore and play.

[b]Join the Celebration:[/b]

Event Duration: 21st June to 30th June
How to Participate: Log in to Piffsy during the event period and join the festivities in the Pride Event Zone.
This event is all about celebrating love, acceptance, and unity. We believe that everyone should feel welcome and appreciated, and this event is our way of showing that Piffsy is a place for everyone.


[h1][b]Our Creator Tool & Marketplace have NOW LAUNCHED![/b] 🎉[/h1]

Unleash your creativity and design your own custom clothing. Not only can you create, but you can also sell and buy unique designs from other players! 

[b]Key Highlights: [/b]

👗 Design and showcase your unique style. 

🛒 Buy custom-designed clothing (Premium members can sell their creations). 

✔️ All clothing items are subject to staff review. 

📢 Content creators can now add their logos to a t-shirt in-game! Get in touch with us at [url=Marketing@piffsy.com]Marketing@piffsy.com[/url] for more details.

Get started today in-game and manage all your submitted creations on our website at any time.

We can't wait to see you in-game, celebrating with us. Let's make this Pride Event a memorable one, filled with joy, love, and positivity.

[b]Stay Connected:[/b]

Follow us on our social media channels for the latest updates, event highlights, and community stories.

- [url=https://x.com/PiffsyOfficial]Twitter[/url]
- [url=https://www.facebook.com/people/Piffsy/61556403749581/]Facebook[/url]
- [url=https://www.instagram.com/piffsy_official/]Instagram[/url]
- [url=discord.gg/vxt]Discord[/url]

Thank you for being a part of the Piffsy community. Together, we can create a world where everyone feels loved and included.

Happy Pride, everyone! 🎉🏳️‍🌈

Best regards,

Piffsy Team

notes.title: Patch [2.0.4.27]
notes.content:
Patch [2.0.4.27] - Game Client
===============================

[What's Fixed?]

▶ Minor avatar customization fixes.

▶ The `Bruce` NPC no longer knocks out mounts when a player is knocked out whilst mounted.

▶ Waypoint markers no longer render when a player is close to the target.

[What's Changed?]

▶ Clothing textures and thumbnails are now cached locally to prevent reloading every time.

▶ Improvements to loading times on player apartment textures.

▶ Default key bind for voice chat push to talk is now `Page Down`.

▶ Game UI now scales with the screen resolution by default.

▶ Minor tweaks to mini game mechanics.

[What's New?]

▶ Creator 2.0 Tool is now live and accessible from `Esc` menu.

▶ Clothing Wardrobe in avatar now has a text search feature.

▶ Game Settings now has key bindings for various in-game actions.

▶ Chat now has an auto complete feature for /emotes.

▶ Shortcut bar now has icons for `Marketplace` & `Rankings`.

▶ Local, World & Party chat colour text can now be customized in settings.

Patch [2.0.0] - Creator
=================

▶ Initial Public Release

notes.title: Piffsy 2.0 Official Trailer 2 - BEST FREE GAME OF 2024 RELEASE DATE!
notes.content:
[b]We are thrilled to announce that Piffsy 2.0 will be released on June 14th, 2024![/b]

🎉 [b]Free for All Players![/b]

Piffsy 2.0 will be completely free to play!

🎁[b] Limited Edition Free Gold Pet for Early Sign-Ups![/b]

To celebrate the launch, we're offering an exclusive reward. Sign up during the first week to claim a limited edition free gold pet! This special pet is a unique in-game companion, featuring stunning gold accents and exclusive abilities that will enhance your gameplay. It’s our way of thanking you for being an early supporter of Piffsy 2.0.

🌟 [b]Thank You for 1000 Wishlists on Steam![/b]

We’ve hit 1000 wishlists on Steam! Thank you for your support and enthusiasm.

✨ [b]What’s New in Piffsy 2.0?[/b]

Enhanced Features: Enjoy a more thrilling experience in our social MMO, filled with engaging mini games and quests.
Revamped Graphics: Immerse yourself in upgraded visuals and animations.
Expanded Customization: Personalize your avatar and customize your apartment with a wider range of options.
Improved Interface: Navigate seamlessly with a sleek, intuitive interface.
New Challenges: Discover exciting new mini games and quests that will keep you entertained for hours.
Exclusive Events: Participate in special in-game events and competitions offering unique rewards.
Optimized Performance: Experience smoother, faster gameplay with improved performance.

🔄 [b]Account Continuity[/b]

All accounts from v1.0 have been retained, ensuring a smooth transition into Piffsy 2.0 with your prior in-game currency.

🎨 [b]Creators Platform: Crafting Your Imagination[/b]

The beloved Creators Platform is making a comeback! It will be available soon after launch.

💎 [b]Premium Pass[/b]

Unlock even more with our Premium Pass, offering exclusive content, enhanced rewards, and special perks to elevate your Piffsy 2.0 experience.

📢 [b]Attention Creators and Streamers[/b]

We’re eager to collaborate with you! If you're a content creator or streamer interested in working with us, please contact us at Support@piffsy.com.

Get ready to embark on an unforgettable adventure. June 14th, 2024 is just around the corner!

With excitement and gratitude,
The Piffsy Team
